content: PolicyKit1 supervision gap closed: polkit-dinit provides polkit-elogind-dinit (conversion resolves), dbus_audit_coverage harness gate (dinit, parses audit summary in installer.log). Confirmed: dinit 136/136, OpenRC 109/109. Also btrbk 0.32 config fix (snapshots now real), pages-race artifact staging live, turnstile stop-order.

Hardening family consolidated: hardening-config r2 = static sysctls 93-99 + family deps (apparmor/clamav/set-permissions); set-permissions r0 enabled at boot both inits; debug drop-in 99-feralos-debug; clamav enablement moved to the hardening-config packageLogic key (deps-installed packages need their rules keys on the family package). dinit 136/136, OpenRC 109/109 confirmed.

btrbk runs as ROOT via root's crontab; no btrbk user/group created (Alpine package creates none; dedicated user = SSH-remote scenario only). The removed run_as option was the only reason a btrbk user made sense — dropped upstream in btrbk 0.32.

Docs round: package-configs (hardening r2 family consolidation + set-permissions row + clamav-config r1 freshclam.conf), security_stack (clamav deps + enablement via hardening-config key), feature_confinement (hardening family note), storage (btrbk 0.32 syntax + the zero-snapshots story), harness artifacts (btrbk_config/btrbk_snapshot/config_packages_hardening/dbus_audit_coverage rows), variables.md (feralosRepoUrl override). Final proof: dinit 136/136, OpenRC 109/109.
